description: Mint a temporary signed download URL for a file in Rebase storage. It returns the URL and its expiry, not object metadata — the URL is a bearer capability that outlives the tool call.

key.description: Key/path/url of the file to download

project.description: The project to act on: a registered project's name (rebase_project_list), or a Rebase Cloud project's slug or id. Optional when the session's directory is linked to the intended project. Refused when it names a different project than the directory's link.

name: storage_get_download_url
